## 8. Models

<!-- models:start (generated by tools/process_models.mjs; edit outside these markers) -->

- **Tilt-Shift** (`lumenary:tilt-shift`, models this process): A tilt-shift lens tips its plane of focus so that only a thin band is sharp and the rest falls quickly into blur. That is also what happens when you photograph a tiny scene up close, so a street photographed this way tricks the brain into seeing a model. Boost… Model: `processes/models/lumenary/tilt-shift.json`; theory: `treatments/lumenary/theory/08-optical.md`.
